description: Research question: Does the Ferrule build tool support incremental builds on Windows? [1] Ferrule official docs, 'Platform support' page, updated 2026-08-04: 'Incremental builds are supported on Linux and macOS. On Windows, `--incremental` is accepted but ignored: every build is a full build.' [2] Blog post 'Making Ferrule fly on Windows' by an independent developer, 2026-09-02, 1.2k upvotes: 'Incremental builds do work on Windows: set FERRULE_FS_WATCH=polling and my rebuilds went from 40 s to 3 s.'

expected_outcome.description: A report in the required format (a direct answer, `Source facts` with inline citations, `Interpretation`, a `Sources:` list and a `Confidence:` line) whose answer is that Ferrule does not officially support incremental builds on Windows, per its docs [1], and which reports the blog's `FERRULE_FS_WATCH=polling` workaround [2] as an unofficial, unverified claim from an independent post, not as supported behaviour. That is all that is required.
